## Security fix

This release includes the fix for CVE-2026-105544, an elevation of privilege vulnerability in the VSTest artifact post-processor. The post-processor could consume a forged `executionComplete.json` written by another local user, and then run attacker-controlled output handling.

Affected: `Microsoft.TestPlatform.CLI` 18.11.0 and earlier. Every version from 18.11.1 on is fixed, including 18.12.0.

`Microsoft.TestPlatform.CLI` is the VSTest build that we ship into the .NET SDK. The recommended way to get this fix is to update your .NET SDK to the latest patched version, see the advisory for the SDK versions.

The fix is also released in the `Microsoft.TestPlatform.CLI` package, for completeness. That package is rarely used directly. It is not a dependency of `Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk` or `Microsoft.TestPlatform`, so those packages do not bring it in.

Details: https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/issues/16654 and https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/517

Using custom Docker images or Nano Server? See https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/issues/16652

## What's Changed
* Fix TestCaseStart/Stop events dropped for data-driven tests with shared TestCase.Id by @nohwnd in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16033
* Stop the discovery manager factory from shadowing discoveryCriteria by @nohwnd in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16391
* Gate the HTTP link checker on a fingerprint of the broken links by @nohwnd in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16413
* Quote boolean conditions in shipped Microsoft.TestPlatform.targets by @nohwnd in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16404
* Obsolete API hygiene: the compatibility-safe changes by @azat-msft in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16420
* Add xxHash128 test ids, available but not default by @azat-msft in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16378
* Isolate attachment manager test temporary files by @mmitche in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16463
* Test ids report logger by @azat-msft in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16443
* Isolate code coverage files in published output by @azat-msft in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16483
* Preserve OutputType for Android test projects by @jonathanpeppers in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16496
* Fix dotnet host resolution under proot (ARM64/Termux) by @azat-msft in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16462
* Mark the xxHash128 test id API as experimental by @azat-msft in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16465
* Ship Microsoft.Diagnostics.NETCore.Client in Microsoft.TestPlatform and Portable packages by @nohwnd in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16633
* Fix localized resource paths in CLI source-build/non-Windows packages by @nohwnd in https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/pull/16644


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/compare/v18.11.0...v18.12.0
